_comment: The Windows scoreboard. Every `skip:` in a test file is listed here, by file and reason; scripts/invariants.test.mjs fails the build on an unlisted gate and on a stale entry, so a new gate cannot be added silently and a removed one cannot linger. kind: 'asymmetry' is a real, agreed platform difference and must name a counterpart test asserting the other side; 'capability' skips only on a machine lacking a tool (it runs on every CI leg); 'temporary' is a gate that will be removed and must name the PR that removes it. Empty since Phase 3: every gate was in the TS core and agent, and the Rust crates gate with cfg instead.
